title: Kundalik fe'llar
hook_voice: Lesson twenty. Go, eat, drink, sleep.
hook_say: Har kuni qiladigan ishlaringizni inglizcha aytamiz!

example.en: I eat bread and drink tea.
example.uz: Men non yeyman va choy ichaman.

end_say: Saqlab qo'ying! Ertaga yigirma birinchi darsda ko'rishamiz.
caption:
0 dan ingliz tili, 20-dars: inglizcha kundalik fe'llar.

I eat bread — Men non yeyman
I drink tea — Men choy ichaman
I go home — Men uyga boraman

Yana bitta fe'l: sleep — uxlamoq. I sleep — Men uxlayman. Gap tartibi: avval kim (I), keyin fe'l.
Saqlab qo'ying va ingliz tilini boshlamoqchi bo'lgan do'stingizga yuboring.
Ertaga 21-dars: Hozirgi zamon.
